model: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst Edit (edit:openai_gpt_image_2_5_sunburst_edit, high, 1152x2048) opening still -> same model final still edited from it -> Seedance 2.5 (video:seedance_2_5, 9:16, 5s, 720p, sound on) from the opening still (first_frame_url) to the final still (end_image_url)

inputs.what_happens: text, the action from first frame to last in seconds, then the sounds

outputs.final-still: PNG, same size as the opening still
